description: Rerank retrieved documents by relevance to a query with a cross-encoder (bge-reranker-base), the last step of a RAG or search pipeline: send a query and up to 100 documents (strings or {id, text}) and get them back best first with 0-1 relevance scores. Cohere-style output (index, relevance_score, document); top_n and min_score filters. One flat price per call. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

documents.description: Up to 100 strings or {id, text} objects

return_documents.description: Include each document's text, first 500 characters (default true)

top_n.description: Return only the best n (default all)

name: rerank_documents
